scripts.build: pnpm --filter @trusttrove/sdk build && pnpm --filter @trusttrove/sdk-react build && pnpm --filter @trusttrove/cli build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @trusttrove/sdk test && pnpm --filter @trusttrove/sdk-react test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @trusttrove/sdk build && pnpm --filter @trusttrove/sdk-react build && pnpm --filter @trusttrove/cli build && pnpm -r exec tsc --noEmit
